newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Turner International Advertising to open Singapore office.
newsitem.headline: Turner International Advertising to open Singapore office.

text.p: Turner International Advertising Sales plans to open an office in Singapore next year to strengthen its operations in the Asia-Pacific region, the company said on Thursday.
"This announcement underscores the company's worldwide efforts to bolster its regionally focused sales strategy," senior vice president Carl Meyer said in a press release issued in Hong Kong.
Turner International Advertising Sales is a unit of Turner Broadcasting System Inc, which was acquired by Time Warner Inc last month. It now has offices in Hong Kong and Tokyo.
The company also said Peter Brack and Dave Dickman had been promoted to regional sales directors.

Brack will move from Hong Kong to Singapore next year to manage regional advertising sales for Turner's international networks, which include Cable News Network International, TNT and the Cartoon Network, it said.
